alternatives.name: Warren bay (production)
alternatives.note: one diagonal per face, alternating; lightest, single shear path

alternatives.name: X-braced bay
alternatives.note: two crossing tension diagonals; fail-safe in shear, +diag mass

alternatives.name: Portal bay (open)
alternatives.note: rigid frames, no diagonals; open for equipment removal, frame bending governs

L3.joint: module frame (deep, Ti nodes), 15 (6 rails) or 12 (3 rails) splice points
L3.alignment: three kinematic cones per module frame (one per sector) set the datum; splice plates take the rails; laser tracker + FBG
L3.transport: 8 m module: 10-12 m diameter, 15-35 t; launch from the lunar yard by mass driver or tug as one piece
L3.orbital_joining: friction-stir or bolted splice per rail (6 or 3), frames bolted; 1 splice pair per rail per 8 m

L4.name: propulsion
L4.note: thrust ring, pickups, transition; Ti nodes; magnetic exclusion (no ferritic steel)

L4.name: power
L4.note: L1/L2 units 3 x 96.9 t on module frames; stiffness and spectra OPEN

L4.name: hot loop
L4.note: H6a trunks on 6.4 m saddles; anchor per 25.4 m; bulkhead at X ~40.8

L4.name: equipment
L4.note: racks and ORUs on rail hard-points; MRU lane az 270

L4.name: workshop
L4.note: module 10 dry store, workshop; portal bays for removal

L4.name: radiator
L4.note: blade roots at az 90/210/330 frame lugs (backbone trade 3.6)

L4.name: rotating habitat
L4.note: rotor bay: collar (bypass) or hub path; ring keep-out r 31.5 m

L4.name: cryo
L4.note: tank farm on the common thrust deck; cryocoolers forward

L4.name: forward shielding
L4.note: Brow interface ring; forward defense owns the Brow truss

interface: common end fitting: Ti-6Al-4V spigot with two-flange bolt circle per class, FBG fibre pass-through and an alignment key; any cassette of a class fits any node socket of that class
